### Cards by class

The unscripted truth plants no moment: it lists goals, red cards and shots. A card on a goal or a red card matches a truth moment; a chance or save card is an extra card by design (a shot whose xG times its potential swing reaches 8 points); it is grounded (`extra_*`) when its shot is in the truth with the outcome the card claims and, for a save, the keeper's action is the message right after the shot. `mispaired_save`: a save card whose keeper action is not the one right after its shot (see the notes); `ungrounded_*`: no matching truth shot.

## 3. Robustness to extra network trouble

Each stream is replayed with extra perturbations on top of the feed's own late and duplicated messages (arrival times change, messages do not; the pipeline's clock is the arrival time). A match is identical when every card (kind, status, version, player, value, facts, score before), every card action and the final score are the same as on the unperturbed feed.

| Perturbation | Within the 3 s buffer | Unscripted identical | Demo identical | First differences |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| every message delayed by 0-2 s (reorders neighbours) | yes | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| 5 % of messages sent again 0-60 s later | yes | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| 5 % of messages delayed by 0.5-2.5 s | yes | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| 0-1 s jitter, 5 % duplicates, 5 % delayed 0.5-1.9 s | yes | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| every message delayed by 0-6 s | no | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| 5 % of messages delayed by 4-10 s | no | 100/100 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |
| 2 % of messages delayed by 30-120 s | no | 99/100 (99.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) | synthetic-0078: card card-synthetic-0078-v2-a00023 missing |
| each corrected goal arrives 5 s after its correction (matches with a corrected goal only; compares the cards a viewer sees) | no | 18/18 (100.0 %) | 1/1 (100.0 %) |  |

## 4. Timing in feed time

## Live run, production prompt

Not generated by `python -m worker.evaluate`, which never calls a model: one pass of the demo match through the live pipeline with the Foundry Writer and the production prompt (`WRITER_INSTRUCTIONS` in `src/worker/writer.py`), measured afterwards by `python -m worker.measure` from what the desk stored. The pass below is the reference replay of 26/10/2026 in Azure: the replay job published the demo match at ten times real speed, the worker in Container Apps wrote with the Foundry Writer in judging mode (auto-approve), and the desk stored everything in Cosmos DB. The full output of `python -m worker.measure` and a few of the documents, copied as they are, are in `docs/samples/`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Date | 26/10/2026, 03:54 to 04:19 UTC |
| Match | demo-0007 (seed 7, scripted), 1,748 messages, final score 5-2 |
| Model (deployment) | gpt-5.4-nano, GlobalStandard, 50k tokens a minute |
| Reasoning effort | medium for the cards and their duo; low for the recap |
| max_tokens | 5,000 for the cards; 6,000 for the recap (reasoning included) |
| prompt_sha | `3635bc733780` (Writer), `26e54d67aab9` (recap) |
| Prices used for the cost | none: the cost is read from the Azure bill, not estimated here |

| | Cards | Recap |
|---|---|---|
| Writes | 12 (11 cards, 1 rewrite) | 1 |
| Written by the model | 12/12 | 0/1 (template after 2 model attempts) |
| Verified at the first attempt | 11 | 0 |
| Verified at the second attempt | 1 | 0 |
| Fallback cause | none | verifier (numbers without a claim, then an invalid reply) |
| finish_reason | stop 13/13 | stop 2/2 |
| HTTP 429 answers | 0 | 0 |
| Latency per attempt, p50 / p95 (s) | 24.4 / 31.5 | 15.3 / 17.8 |
| Tokens in / out (reasoning) | 139,586 / 42,044 (30,949) | 7,961 / 4,399 (1,134) |
| Model calls against the cap of 40 | 13 | 2 |

Insights and the storyline are written by the templates live (`--insights-writer template`, the default), so they make no model call. An earlier local pass the same night, with 3,000 output tokens and medium effort for both writers, had 5 replies out of 21 cut short (finish_reason `length`), 5 of 11 model cards verified at the first attempt, and the recap cut twice while reasoning; the budget above comes from that pass. The insights are written by the templates in the live pipeline; the recap stays a template whenever the model's draft fails the Verifier.

To reproduce, after a replay of the match in Azure (the worker writes to Cosmos DB; queries only, signed in with `az login`):

```
python -m worker.measure --cosmos demo-0007 --price-in <USD per million input tokens> --price-out <USD per million output tokens> --out measure.md
```

Or locally, on a fresh desk folder (this calls the model: up to 40 calls for the match, plus 2 for the recap):

```
python -m worker.reset --match demo-0007 --desk-dir data/desk --yes
python -m worker data/replay/demo-0007.jsonl.gz --writer foundry --auto-approve --desk-dir data/desk --history data/history/9 --league-seed 9 --matchday 30
python -m worker.recap data/desk/demo-0007 --writer foundry
python -m worker.measure data/desk/demo-0007 --price-in <USD> --price-out <USD> --out measure.md
```

The model, effort, max_tokens and prompt_sha come from `writer_config` on the documents (the last table of the output); a run stored without the trace fields is still measured, and the output says which numbers it cannot give.
